data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: Validation sprint runs end-to-end (confirmed by this task's final report)
- DD2: All mechanical proxies pass (report documents all 5 proxy outcomes)
- DD3: Inline value-signal assertion re-reviewed-LOC / total-LOC < 50% holds

## Description
Run `compute-rereviewed-loc.sh` against the sprint output from T4, assert the ratio is below the 50% threshold, and produce the committed findings report.

### Execution
1. Determine the session dir and story IDs from the completed sprint:
   ```bash
   SESSION_DIR=$(ls -d .sprint-artifacts/sessions/*/ 2>/dev/null | tail -1)
   STORY_IDS=$(git log --merges --format='%s' origin/main..HEAD | grep -oP '(?<=DSO-Story: )\S+')
   ```
2. Run the measurement:
   ```bash
   REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)
   $REPO/plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/compute-rereviewed-loc.sh "$SESSION_DIR" $STORY_IDS > /tmp/ratio-result.txt
   RATIO=$(grep '^RATIO:' /tmp/ratio-result.txt | cut -d: -f2)
   TOTAL=$(grep '^TOTAL_LOC:' /tmp/ratio-result.txt | cut -d: -f2)
   REREVIEW=$(grep '^REREVIEWED_LOC:' /tmp/ratio-result.txt | cut -d: -f2)
   ```
3. Assert threshold:
   ```bash
   python3 -c "ratio=float('$RATIO'); assert ratio < 0.50, f'THRESHOLD FAILED: {ratio:.2f} >= 0.50'"
   ```
   If assertion fails: document the actual ratio in the findings report as a THRESHOLD_FAILED outcome. Do NOT mark the story complete if ratio ≥ 0.50 — file a follow-on bug ticket instead.
4. Read proxy-check-results.md from T4 output.
5. Write `docs/findings/validation-sprint-<VALIDATION_EPIC_ID>.md` with:
   - Validation date and sprint session ID
   - Candidate epic ID, title, and story count
   - Total LOC, re-reviewed LOC, ratio
   - THRESHOLD: PASS (ratio < 0.50) or THRESHOLD: FAILED (ratio ≥ 0.50)
   - Mechanical proxy results (copy from proxy-check-results.md)
   - Key observations and follow-on recommendations

### Doc-Router Gate
Gate 3 fires (findings content, project-local): target is `docs/findings/validation-sprint-<VALIDATION_EPIC_ID>.md`.

## File Impact
- `docs/findings/validation-sprint-<VALIDATION_EPIC_ID>.md` (create)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `docs/findings/validation-sprint-*.md` exists in docs/findings/
  Verify: ls $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/docs/findings/validation-sprint-*.md 2>/dev/null | grep -q .
- [ ] Findings report contains THRESHOLD: PASS or THRESHOLD: FAILED section
  Verify: grep -q 'THRESHOLD:' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/docs/findings/validation-sprint-*.md
- [ ] Findings report contains RATIO: value
  Verify: grep -q 'RATIO:' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/docs/findings/validation-sprint-*.md
- [ ] Findings report contains TOTAL_LOC ≥ 1500
  Verify: python3 -c "import re; content=open('$(ls $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/docs/findings/validation-sprint-*.md | head -1)').read(); total=int(re.search(r'TOTAL_LOC:.*?(\d+)', content).group(1)); assert total >= 1500, f'Only {total} LOC'"
- [ ] If THRESHOLD: PASS, story DDs are satisfied and story can be closed
  Verify: grep -q 'THRESHOLD: PASS' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/docs/findings/validation-sprint-*.md && echo "ready to close" || echo "THRESHOLD FAILED — do not close story"
- [ ] Findings report contains all 5 mechanical proxy outcomes
  Verify: grep -cE 'Proxy (A|B|C|D|E)|proxy-(a|b|c|d|e)' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/docs/findings/validation-sprint-*.md | awk '{exit ($1 < 5)}'
- [ ] DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION emitted in completion report
  Verify: (sub-agent emits DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION in its completion report — checked by orchestrator)

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Assert re-review ratio < 50% and produce validation findings report
